f1417fbf2236936e8334533628b2948dfa4a46d0

Vendored subset of https://github.com/RetroAchievements/rcheevos at the
commit above. Only the sources this port links are kept:

  src/{rc_client,rc_compat,rc_util,rc_version}.c
  src/rapi/*.c        -- server request/response marshalling
  src/rcheevos/*.c    -- the trigger/condition evaluator
  src/rhash/md5.c     -- MD5, used for the GBA ROM hash

Deliberately NOT vendored:
  src/rhash/*         -- everything except md5.c. The GBA hash is just the
                         MD5 of the whole ROM, which the port already has in
                         memory (gRomData), so the file/disc/zip readers that
                         the rest of rhash exists for are dead weight here.
  src/rc_libretro.*, src/rc_client_external.*, src/rc_client_raintegration.*
  src/rcheevos/rc_validate.c -- achievement-editor validation only, and it
                         does not compile clean under devkitARM (it passes
                         uint32_t* where unsigned* is expected; uint32_t is
                         'long unsigned' on this ABI).

No local modifications to the vendored sources: keep it that way so the
next update is a straight re-copy.
